scientific_role: specification outcome-free within-person state discovery and three-epoch trajectory analysis before any latent-state fit

observation_unit.state_observation: one epoch observation within one participant and one trial
observation_unit.trajectory_unit: one common trial with stimulus_early, stimulus_late, and rating_early
observation_unit.participant_modeling: one independent latent-state model per eligible discovery participant

primary_representation.feature_inclusion: finite fraction >= 0.90 separately in every epoch family for that participant
preprocessing_order: within participant and epoch family, median-impute retained features
within participant and epoch family, subtract feature median
divide by epoch-family IQR; if an epoch-family IQR is <= floor, use participant-pooled IQR for that feature
drop a feature if pooled IQR is also <= floor
fit PCA within participant after stacking all three epoch families

pca.actual_components: minimum of fixed_components, retained_features, and observations_minus_one

primary_representation.rationale: epoch-family-specific robust centering prevents trivial stage location/scale differences from defining states while retaining within-stage trial variation and cross-stage trajectories

state_model.canonical_label_rule: sort full-fit state centroids lexicographically by PCA coordinate 1, then 2, etc.; never by report association

state_count_and_stability.resampling_unit: trial; all three epoch observations remain coupled in every resample
state_count_and_stability.comparison: adjusted Rand index between full-fit labels and resample-fit labels on retained observations
state_count_and_stability.collapse_definition: any state has fewer than 8 observations or fewer than 4 unique trials
state_count_and_stability.selection_rule: among eligible K, choose the smallest K with BIC <= minimum eligible BIC + 10
state_count_and_stability.no_eligible_k_rule: declare no stable discrete-state solution for that participant; retain continuous PCA trajectories and do not force clusters

discrete_when_available: state at stimulus_early, stimulus_late, and rating_early
per-epoch occupancy, transition matrices, persistence, switching, and path entropy
continuous_for_every_eligible_participan: PCA score vectors at each epoch
segment norms, total path length, direct displacement, directness ratio, and segment cosine when defined

null.scheme: within participant, independently permute trial linkage for stimulus_late and rating_early while preserving each epoch occupancy and keeping stimulus_early fixed
null.p_value: one-sided add-one randomization p-value for excess structured persistence/information

diagnostic_only_after_state_lock.qc_association: summarize QC by prespecified state after assignments are written; QC never enters primary state fit or K selection
diagnostic_only_after_state_lock.epoch_association: summarize residual epoch-family association after stage-centering; never revise states
diagnostic_only_after_state_lock.context_and_reports: forbidden in latent_state_fit; deferred to a separate post-hoc mapping phase after state assignments and trajectories are hashed

cross_person_alignment.deferred_role: later outcome-free layer using prespecified participant state centroids in the common 169-cell compact feature axes

claim_guardrails: a latent state is a reproducible partition of this representation, not ground truth for subjective experience
failure to obtain stable discrete states does not imply absent neurophysiological structure
context or participant separability is not emotion decoding
no best epoch is selected from prior outer-test results
state discovery and post-hoc report mapping remain separate phases
forbidden: reading valence, liking, arousal, emotion reports, labels, or report-derived factors during latent_state_design or latent_state_fit
choosing K, PCA dimensionality, features, participant inclusion, or state labels from report/context association
using secondary_models outer-test performance to select an epoch family
including QC cells in the primary state representation
